name: Hommlet
notes: Small village in the Kron Hills foothills, 30 miles southeast of Verbobonc on the road to Nulb. Nominally under the protection of the Viscount of Verbobonc. Site of the Temple of Elemental Evil's resurgence; an old moathouse to the east serves as the cult's local stronghold.

notableNPCs.name: Burne
notableNPCs.notes: Co-rules Hommlet with Rufus. Member of the Viscount's council. Building a new keep on the rise overlooking the village.

notableNPCs.name: Rufus
notableNPCs.notes: Co-rules Hommlet with Burne. Veteran fighter and Burne's longtime partner; oversees construction of the new keep.

notableNPCs.name: Elmo
notableNPCs.notes: Plays the part of the village drunk as cover. Actually a Viscount's agent embedded to identify Temple cultists.

notableNPCs.name: Y'dey
notableNPCs.role: High priestess, Church of St. Cuthbert; cleric (7th level)
notableNPCs.notes: Coordinates quietly with Burne and Rufus against the Temple's resurgence. The small church on the rise is hers.

notableNPCs.name: Gundigoot
notableNPCs.role: Proprietor, Inn of the Welcome Wench
notableNPCs.notes: Genial innkeeper. Hears most of what passes through Hommlet.
